title: When the Semester Turns
author: August Reyes
blurb: Jude Sandoval, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
